_comment: Seed catalogue for apps.products. Run: python manage.py seed_products. Every product carries a freely-licensed Wikimedia Commons photo in image_url, each one visually checked, with the attribution its licence requires in image_credit. A product added without image_url still gets a generated placeholder card, so nothing ever renders blank — but the shipped catalogue is all photographs.

products.name: Hybrid Maize Seed
products.description: Improved maize varieties bred for higher yields and better drought tolerance than saved seed. Buy fresh each season — hybrid seed saved from your own harvest loses much of its vigour.

products.name: Improved Cassava Cuttings
products.description: Disease-free stem cuttings from certified nurseries, selected for resistance to cassava mosaic virus. Plant within a few days of collection and keep them shaded until then.

products.name: Certified Upland Rice Seed
products.description: NERICA-type upland rice seed suited to rainfed fields without standing water. Matures faster than traditional varieties, which helps when the rains end early.

products.name: Cowpea Seed
products.description: Certified cowpea for grain and fodder. It fixes nitrogen in the soil, so it is a good crop to rotate into a field that has carried maize for a season or two.

products.name: Heat-Tolerant Tomato Seed
products.description: Varieties selected to set fruit in high temperatures, where ordinary tomato flowers drop. Start in a nursery bed and transplant after three to four weeks.

products.name: Groundnut Seed
products.description: Shelled groundnut seed graded for planting rather than eating. Shell only just before sowing, as shelled kernels lose their ability to germinate quickly.

products.name: Vegetable Seed Assortment
products.description: A mixed pack of okra, amaranth, garden egg and pepper seed for a home or market garden. Useful for spreading risk across several quick-maturing crops.

products.name: NPK 15-15-15 Fertiliser
products.description: Balanced compound fertiliser supplying nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium in equal share. Usually applied at or shortly after planting as a base dressing.

products.name: Organic Compost
products.description: Decomposed plant and animal matter that feeds the soil rather than just the crop. It improves water retention in sandy soils and eases compaction in clay.

products.name: Neem-Based Bio-Pesticide
products.description: Plant-derived pesticide that deters aphids, whitefly and caterpillars with a short pre-harvest interval. A practical choice for vegetables picked frequently.

products.name: Mancozeb Fungicide
products.description: Protective fungicide against blight, leaf spot and downy mildew. It works by preventing infection, so spray before disease takes hold rather than after.
products.image_credit: David Gent, USDA Agricultural Research Service, Bugwood.org / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0 us)

products.name: Hand Hoe
products.description: The everyday tool for weeding, ridging and seedbed preparation. A forged head lasts far longer than a pressed one and is worth the difference in price.

products.name: Cutlass / Machete
products.description: For clearing bush, harvesting cane and plantain, and general field work. Keep the edge sharpened — a blunt blade takes more effort and slips more easily.

products.name: Knapsack Sprayer (16 L)
products.description: Backpack sprayer for applying pesticide, herbicide and foliar feed. Rinse thoroughly between different chemicals, especially after herbicide.

products.name: Drip Irrigation Starter Kit
products.description: Tubing, emitters and fittings that deliver water straight to the root zone. Uses far less water than furrow irrigation and keeps leaves dry, which limits disease.
products.image_credit: Willem van Aken, CSIRO / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 3.0)

products.name: Spraying Protective Kit
products.description: Gloves, goggles, respirator mask and coverall for handling agrochemicals. Pesticide absorbed through skin and lungs causes lasting harm — wear the set every time.
products.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by Photographer's Mate 2nd Class Timothy Smith / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

products.name: Rice
products.description: Grown in lowland paddies or as rainfed upland rice. Demand in urban markets is strong and much is still imported, so locally milled rice sells well.

products.name: Sorghum
products.description: A hardy cereal that yields where maize fails, tolerating heat and irregular rain. Used for food, brewing and animal feed.

products.name: Millet
products.description: Drought-tolerant small grain well suited to sandy soils and short rainy seasons. Reliable in the drier savannah where other cereals are a gamble.
products.image_credit: लोकपर्याय, लोणी-खु ता.वैजापूर,जि.औरंगाबाद, / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

products.name: Cassava
products.description: A root crop that tolerates poor soil and can stay in the ground until needed. Processed into gari, fufu and flour, and it spoils fast once lifted.

products.name: Yam
products.description: A high-value tuber, central to both diet and ceremony in West Africa. Needs deep, loose soil and staking, and stores for months in a well-ventilated barn.

products.name: Sweet Potato
products.description: Fast-maturing tuber that produces on sandy soil with modest inputs. Orange-fleshed varieties carry vitamin A and command a premium in some markets.

products.name: Groundnut
products.description: Grown for food, oil and paste, and a good rotation crop after cereals. Dry the pods properly: damp storage invites aflatoxin, which buyers reject.

products.name: Soybean
products.description: Rising demand from oil mills and poultry feed processors makes this a dependable cash legume. Needs inoculant on soil where it has not been grown before.

products.name: Bambara Nut
products.description: An indigenous legume that yields on poor, sandy soil where groundnut struggles. Nutritious, drought-hardy and mostly traded in local markets.

products.name: Tomato
products.description: A high-value vegetable with fast turnover and heavy post-harvest losses. Prices swing widely between glut and scarcity, so timing the planting matters.

products.name: Onion
products.description: Stores far better than most vegetables, letting you hold stock for a stronger price. Cure the bulbs in shade for two weeks before bagging.
products.image_credit: Photo by Derek Ramsey (Ram-Man) / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.5)

products.name: Okra
products.description: Quick to mature and picked every couple of days once it starts bearing. Steady household demand and it tolerates heat well.

products.name: Pepper (Chilli)
products.description: Sold fresh or dried, with drying offering a way to store the crop and sell later. Susceptible to blight in humid weather.

products.name: Plantain
products.description: A perennial that yields year-round once established, giving steady income between seasonal crops. Prefers deep, moist soil rich in organic matter.

products.name: Mango
products.description: Tree crop with a concentrated harvest window and strong fresh and dried demand. Fruit fly is the main threat to marketable quality.

products.name: Pineapple
products.description: Grows well on acidic sandy loam and suits both fresh sale and juice processing. Takes roughly 12 to 18 months from sucker to harvest.
products.image_credit: Pineapple Supply Co. pineapple / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)

products.name: Cocoa
products.description: A leading export earner in West Africa, sold as dried fermented beans. Fermentation and drying decide the grade, and the grade decides the price.

products.name: Cashew
products.description: Tolerates poor, dry soil and yields for decades once the trees mature. Raw nuts are exported, while processing locally adds considerable value.
products.image_credit: Dr. Raju Kasambe / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0)

products.name: Oil Palm
products.description: Fresh fruit bunches pressed for palm oil and kernel oil, with year-round harvesting. Needs high rainfall and mills the fruit within 48 hours of cutting.

products.name: Sesame
products.description: A drought-tolerant oilseed with steady export demand and low input costs. Harvest before the capsules split, or much of the seed is lost to the ground.

products.name: Ginger
products.description: High-value rhizome sold fresh or dried, favouring loose, well-drained soil. Rotate the plot, as ginger is prone to soil-borne rot when grown repeatedly.

products.name: Hibiscus (Sorrel)
products.description: Dried calyces used for drinks and tea, with growing export interest. Undemanding to grow and dries easily in the sun, which keeps processing costs low.
products.image_credit: စာကလေး SarKaLay / Wikimedia Commons (CC0)
